title: SET/STT union-office mediation meeting and arrests
reason: The sources describe a union-office meeting at the STT premises in Lomé, not a public gathering open to a broader audience. No attendance or evidence of 50 participants is reported. The reported three/four detained members and eight arrests overall are arrest counts, not protest turnout.
notes: The news report and union statement differ on whether three or four SET members were arrested at the meeting; the statement attributes its account to the STT coordinator, and the archive repeats that notice. The DMK statement is a political response to the arrests, not evidence of a mass assembly. No public event is inferred.

title: Announced late-January SET 72-hour strike dates without verified execution
reason: The opened accounts document plans, warnings, cancellation of the reported 26 January start, and suspension of a later 28–29 January call; none verifies execution of these announced late-January strike dates as a public mass gathering. Announcements alone are not coded as occurred events.
notes: Reports disagree on planned dates. This exclusion applies only to the specified late-January announced strike calls and does not negate the separate earlier sit-ins/strike report in candidate TGO202101-E001. L’Opinion’s possible Monday school action remains unconfirmed and is retained as a date/execution gap rather than assigned to these calls.
